videos.script: A single-page app loads one page and never loads another. {{spa}} Click a link, and a script draws the next screen and changes the address by itself. The server is asked for data, never for a page. {{click}} That changes what a test can wait for. The address changes first. The content arrives later. A test that trusts the address reads the old screen. {{wait}} It also leaves addresses the server has never heard of. Reload the basket, and the shop answers with a 404. {{deeplink}} Then the progressive web app. A service worker sits between the page and the network, and keeps a copy of the page. Switch the network off, and the page still opens. {{offline}} Keep that copy too long, and a returning visitor runs yesterday's release. A test in a fresh browser never sees it. {{stale}} Last, sites built ahead of time and served from a CDN. There, what you test is the build, not your laptop. {{jamstack}}
